steps.caption: Tabs: Today, Upcoming, Needs preparation, Past, Cancelled and Reports. Open Upcoming.
Connected calendar: link Google or Outlook and new meetings get a preparation page every hour.
No connection? Use Import from your calendar.
Choose the .ics file you exported (here, one meeting with Zentrix tomorrow).
Press Import. Importing the same file again won't create duplicates.
The result says how many meetings were added.
It now appears in the Upcoming list, with its type, company and attendees.
It has its own preparation page: company and attendee were matched from the invite.
Press Prepare brief to get the purpose, people, history and questions.
